mechanism_narrative: Broad recovery in out-of-home activity is self-reinforcing: TRANSIT rising from -47.1 to -37.1 and WORKPLACES rising from -43.6 to -36.4 over the last two weekly means rebuild commuting and errand routines, so the discretionary trips that fund retail-and-recreation continue to accumulate and RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days prints above its last-28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 10.0 points from t-2w to t-0w
fact:WORKPLACES improved 7.2 points from t-2w to t-0w
regime_hint: broad reopening with sequential restriction relaxation
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is at or below its last-28-day mean while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both hold above their t-0w levels.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS crossing above -30 percent of baseline is a behavioural regime marker: outdoor leisure trips resume at near-normal volumes, and those trips bundle with adjacent street-level retail and dining. Once the -30 level is breached, discretionary retail footfall follows within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean crosses above -30 percent of baseline (observed t-0w = -24.1 after -38.7 at t-1w)
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped 14.6 points from t-1w to t-0w and is the least-depressed outdoor series
regime_hint: outdoor-season reopening after a low-mobility trough
failure_condition: PARKS stays above -30 for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC does not exceed its last-28-day mean within 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: The retail recovery is driven by the joint release of household confinement: RESIDENTIAL falling from 11.6 to 9.9 means more person-hours outside the home, while TRANSIT rising from -40.0 to -37.1 supplies the trip channel. Neither alone is sufficient; only their co-movement converts home-time into retail-and-recreation visits.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean falls below 10.0 while TRANSIT simultaneously improves week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined in each of the last three weekly means (14.3, 11.6, 9.9)
fact:TRANSIT gained 2.9 points from t-1w to t-0w
regime_hint: post-lockdown reopening with falling stay-at-home time
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days in the majority of weeks where RESIDENTIAL fell below 10.0 and TRANSIT rose together.

mechanism_narrative: Relaxation of workplace and transit restrictions is the binding constraint on retail-and-recreation capacity. WORKPLACES improving from -43.6 to -36.4 and TRANSIT from -47.1 to -37.1 show that policy-permitted movement is expanding, which mechanically raises the ceiling on allowed retail operations and lifts RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves in two consecutive weekly means (observed -43.6 then -37.3 then -36.4)
evidence_refs: fact:all four mobility series except RESIDENTIAL improved at t-0w relative to t-1w
failure_condition: A new policy-tightening week reverses WORKPLACES and TRANSIT back below -40 while RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days remains below its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing above -40 percent of baseline marks the point where discretionary, non-essential station entries reappear rather than only mandated trips. Those discretionary entries feed directly into retail-and-recreation destinations, so RETAIL_REC improves within one week of the crossing.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean crosses above -40 percent of baseline (observed -37.1 at t-0w after -40.0 at t-1w)
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose above the -40 threshold exactly at t-0w
regime_hint: steady reopening with progressive transit normalization
failure_condition: TRANSIT holds above -40 for the next two weekly means yet RETAIL_REC fails to improve week-on-week by the second week.

mechanism_narrative: Grocery-and-pharmacy mobility rising above -20 while RETAIL_REC remains below -40 indicates trip consolidation: households are compressing all errands into essential channels and skipping discretionary stops. This substitution channel keeps discretionary retail suppressed even as aggregate movement rises.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean above -20 percent of baseline while RETAIL_REC is below -40 percent (observed -18.9 and -40.6 at t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is the least-depressed series at -18.9 while RETAIL_REC is the most-depressed at -40.6
regime_hint: precautionary essential-errand regime with lingering discretionary avoidance
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises decisively above -35 within 7 days while GROCERY_PHARM remains above -20, showing no essential-versus-discretionary substitution.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal outdoor onset pulls activity out of the home: PARKS climbing 14.6 points in one week and RESIDENTIAL slipping below 10 mark the annual shift to outdoor leisure, and outdoor trips in this metro are corridor-linked to retail and dining frontage, so the seasonal shift raises RETAIL_REC across the full four-week horizon.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean falls below 10.0 percent above baseline (observed 9.9 at t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS and RESIDENTIAL moved in opposite directions across all four weekly means
regime_hint: spring outdoor-season transition with declining home confinement
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite PARKS holding above -30 and RESIDENTIAL holding below 10.

mechanism_narrative: Breadth of weekly improvement, not any single series, predicts retail persistence. When RETAIL_REC, TRANSIT and WORKPLACES all improve in the same week, the co-movement reflects a coordinated reopening rather than category-specific noise, and coordinated recoveries extend over a four-week horizon instead of mean-reverting.
candidate_trigger: at least three of the six categories improve week-on-week simultaneously (observed for the t-1w to t-0w transition)
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC, TRANSIT and WORKPLACES all improved from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: After a week with at least three simultaneous category improvements, RETAIL_REC mean over the following 28 days is not higher than its trailing 28-day mean.
